privileged_info_for_vlm: The requirements file is located at /home/ga/Desktop/lab_permission_requirements.txt. The expected configurations in Edge are: Notifications Blocked for youtube.com and facebook.com; Notifications Allowed for teams.microsoft.com; Camera Allowed for zoom.us; Location Allowed for maps.google.com. The final report must be saved to /home/ga/Desktop/permission_config_report.txt. In Edge settings, 'Allow' is represented by value 1 and 'Block' by value 2.
